object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. The tests were written for CHECK and VER. They fail if --repo-root is ignored, because the fallback, the working directory, is a subfolder of a clone and isn't served. Not covered: a path with spaces and non-ASCII letters, which MELLON-MCP-SRS-3's rationale asks for, and a tool call in the same session that names a path in another clone.
object.description: Build a repository in a temporary folder. Start the installed MCP server over standard input and output with --repo-root naming the folder, its working directory a subfolder of another clone and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR left out of its environment, and make several tool calls in one session; then start the server in process with --repo-root and call a tool. Expected: the server starts, and each answer describes the named folder: req-test's validation errors and suspect-link counts with one bad enumeration value added, the changes between two named versions of the built repository, and the links added and removed between two of its commits.
